verdict.rationale: Elicit generates AI insights from the user's own papers inside the product. Chat compares, summarizes and clusters papers; columns extract data points; the Research Agent and Systematic Reviews produce reports and screening recommendations; Zotero and PDF imports bring the user's collections in for analysis. Hands-on reports confirm the core capability works (topic analysis returned cited concepts), though some users found inaccurate or invented summaries. missing for 10: independent corroboration of output accuracy (community reports hallucinated summaries), explicit documentation of proactive suggestions beyond screening recommendations

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Chat enables you to: Compare and contrast papers - Summarize multiple papers along specific dimensions (like their methodologies) - Cluster papers by a certain topic
Elicit's Zotero integration helps you bring your paper collections into Elicit, where you can extract data and analyze your papers!
including the screening recommendation tables and the data extraction table
